title: ALRadioGroup (al-radio-group)
description:
Component: al-radio-group
- **slot**: The radio content, a set of radio items
- **slot** "field-note": If content is slotted, it will display in place of the fieldNote property
- **slot** "error": If content is slotted, it will display in place of the errorNote property

slots.description: The radio content, a set of radio items

slots.name: field-note
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will display in place of the fieldNote property

slots.name: error
slots.description: If content is slotted, it will display in place of the errorNote property

isError.description:
Error state
- Changes the component's treatment to represent an error state

isDisabled.description:
Disabled attribute
- Changes the component's treatment to represent a disabled state

isRequired.description:
Required attribute
- Sets the radio to be required for validation

hideLegend.description:
Hide legend?
- If true, hides the legend from displaying

errorNote.description:
Error message
- An error field note that displays below the radio input

fieldNote.description:
Field note
- The helper text that displays below the radio input

fieldId.description:
Id attribute
- The ID used for A11y and to associate the label with the input

ariaDescribedBy.description:
aria-describedby attribute
- Applied to the field note or error note for A11y
